'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Benjamin D. Kline DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Benjamin D. Kline]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Members of Fear
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
